Message.Name: Time Reference Message
Message.Description: C1 Options Only. The Time Reference message is used to provide a midnight reference point for recipients of the feed. It is sent whenever the system starts up and when the system crosses a midnight boundary. All subsequent Time messages for the same unit will use the last Midnight Reference until another Time Reference message is received for that unit. The Time Reference message includes the Trade Date, so most other sequenced messages will not include that information. Time Reference messages will be included in a spin response.

Field.Name: Midnight Reference
Field.Description: Midnight Eastern time reference time for subsequent Time messages, expressed as number of whole seconds since the Epoch (midnight January 1, 1970 UTC).

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds elapsed since the start of the current Eastern Time calendar day, derived by converting the current Eastern wall clock time (HH:MM:SS) to seconds.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Current Trade Date.

Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is immediately generated and sent when there is an Auction event for a given clock second. If there is no Auction event for a given clock second, then no Time message is sent for that second. All subsequent time offset fields for the same unit will use the new Time value as the base until another Time message is received for the same unit.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds elapsed since the start of the current Eastern Time calendar day, derived by converting the current Eastern wall clock time (HH:MM:SS) to seconds.

Field.Name: Epoch Time
Field.Description: C1 Only. Number of whole seconds since the Epoch (midnight January 1, 1970 UTC).

Message.Name: Unit Clear Message
Message.Description: The Unit Clear message instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the Cboe book in the unit specified in the Sequenced Unit Header. This message will be sent at startup each day. It would also be distributed in certain recovery events such as a data center fail-over.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Auction Notification Message
Message.Description: Auction Notification messages are used to disseminate order details of an auction. Auctions will be available for a defined period of time known as the exposure period.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: B = AIM, S = Solicitation Auction Mechanism, T = Step Up Mechanism (SUM), A = SUM All or None.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: B = Buy Side, S = Sell Side.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: For SUM this will reflect the NBBO price of the opposite side of the auction at the time of entry. For AIM on EDGX, Price will be the auction start price. For SPX/SPXW AIM on C1, Price will be the auction start price, otherwise 0. For SAM, this will reflect the limit price specified on the order.

Field.Name: Contracts
Field.Description: Number of contracts available in the auction.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: N = Non-Customer, C = Customer.

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Executing Broker (optional) of firm attributed to this quote.

Field.Name: Auction End Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last timestamp.

Field.Name: Client ID
Field.Description: Optional user specified value attributed to this quote.

Message.Name: Auction Cancel Message
Message.Description: Auction Cancel messages are used to disseminate the cancellation of an earlier Auction Notification message as a result of a user cancellation of the original order, a user modification request to change the price or increase the original order quantity, or a fading of the NBBO. A user request to modify the order price or to increase the original order quantity will result in a cancellation of the auction followed by a new Auction Notification message. Auction Cancel messages will not be issued for order quantity decrements.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Message.Name: Auction Trade Message
Message.Description: Auction Trade messages are used to disseminate executions resulting from an options auction.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this execution.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Trade price.

Field.Name: Contracts
Field.Description: Number of contracts traded.

Message.Name: Options Auction Update Message
Message.Description: Options Auction Update messages are used to disseminate price and size information and Composite Market bid and offer prices during Opening and Re-Opening (halt) auctions on the Cboe Options Exchange. Options Auction Update messages are sent every five seconds during an opening period provided that one of the field values has changed. When no values have changed, a message is sent once every 60 seconds.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: G = GTH Opening (C1 only), O = RTH Opening (C1 only), H = Halt Re-Opening, V = Volatility Opening.

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: Collared VMIM price computed on the queuing book only.

Field.Name: Buy Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative Buy contracts at the Reference Price and above.

Field.Name: Sell Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative Sell contracts at the Reference Price and below.

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: Collared VMIM price computed on the combined queueing book and the continuous book. Equal to Reference Price for options that do not have a GTH trading session.

Field.Name: Auction Only Price
Field.Description: Uncollared VMIM price computed on the queuing book only.

Field.Name: Opening Condition
Field.Description: O = Would open, Q = Need quote to open, B = Need more buyers (C1 Only), S = Need more sellers (C1 Only), C = Crossed Composite Market.

Field.Name: Composite Market Bid Price
Field.Description: Bid Price of the prevailing Composite Market.

Field.Name: Composite Market Offer Price
Field.Description: Offer Price of the prevailing Composite Market.

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: Auction Summary messages are used to disseminate the results of the Opening and Re-Opening process. An Opening or Re-Opening Auction Summary message for each symbol is sent at the conclusion of the Opening or Re-Opening process and represents the Cboe opening price.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: G = GTH Opening (C1 Only), O = RTH Opening (C1 Only), H = Halt Re-Opening, V = Volatility Opening.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Cumulative number of contracts executed during the auction.

Message.Name: Width Update Message
Message.Description: The Width Update message is used to communicate opening quote width multiplier. This message will be sent in the event that the exchange decides to change the quote width multiplier on a per underlying basis.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Underlying right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Width Type
Field.Description: R = Regular, V = Volatility.

Field.Name: Multiplier
Field.Description: Width multiplier.

Message.Name: Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: A Symbol Mapping message is used to map the 6 character multicast feed symbol field to an OSI symbol. These messages are sent continuously through the day at variable rates as bandwidth allows. Members who consume the Options Auction feed will be able to receive the full list of symbols in approximately 30 minutes.

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: OSI Symbol
Field.Description: OSI Symbol.

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: N = Normal, C = Closing Only.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of underlying instrument right padded with spaces.

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: The End of Session message is sent for each unit when the unit shuts down. No more auction messages will be delivered for this unit, but heartbeats from the unit may be received.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: SOQ Strike Range Update Message
Message.Description: C1 Options Only. The SOQ Strike Range Update message is only available on the C1 Exchange. This message disseminates the minimum and maximum strike prices of the strike price range used to calculate the Special Opening Quote (SOQ) on a Volatility Settlement date. In the event that multiple distinct SOQ calculations occur on the same day, the applicable SOQ is differentiated by the SOQ Identifier field, which is set to the CSMi symbol on which the final settlement SOQ value is disseminated.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: SOQ Identifier
Field.Description: Dissemination symbol of the final SOQ right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Lower Strike Price
Field.Description: SOQ lower strike price.

Field.Name: Upper Strike Price
Field.Description: SOQ upper strike price.

Message.Name: Constituent Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: C1 Options Only. The Constituent Symbol Mapping message is used to communicate which options series (if any) are Constituent Series in a Volatility Settlement Special Opening Quote (SOQ). The message is identical to the Symbol Mapping message with the addition of the SOQ Identifier field, which is set to the CSMi symbol on which the final settlement SOQ value is disseminated. The Constituent Symbol Mapping message is sent as an unsequenced message with one message sent for each Constituent Series in a continuous loop as bandwidth allows.

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: OSI Symbol
Field.Description: OSI Symbol.

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: N = Normal, C = Closing Only.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of underlying equity right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: SOQ Identifier
Field.Description: Dissemination symbol of the final SOQ right padded with spaces.
